name: Titicaca grebe
desc: A flightless, endangered grebe. Nearly 95% of its prey mass is Orestias. It breeds in the reed belt and drowns in gill nets.
about: The Titicaca grebe, also known as the Titicaca flightless grebe or short-winged grebe, is a flightless species of grebe found on the altiplano of Peru and Bolivia.
